verdict.rationale: JumpCloud documents RESTful APIs and a PowerShell module covering core directory services, cross-OS device management, onboarding and offboarding workflows, directory event export, and bulk operations across users, devices, and groups. A published API 2.0 spec (index.yaml) supports graph traversal. However, nothing in the evidence claims or shows full parity with the UI, and the probes found no OpenAPI files at the standard discovery paths. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement or coverage map, evidence that newer modules (password vault, conditional access, MFA config, RADIUS, HRIS) are API-addressable, and independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
